parameters.content:
## Hourly scan
Reads the **Patients** sheet once an hour and sorts rows into three jobs: **reminders**, **new cancellations**, **calendar cleanup**.
State lives in the sheet (*Reminder Sent At*, *Status*), so a rerun never double-sends. Failed sends are retried next hour.

## 24-hour reminder
Only for Tentative/Confirmed bookings with no slot problem.

## Cancellation → waitlist
Staff type **Cancelled** (or *Canceled*) in Status. The next *Waiting* person (same morning/afternoon first, then longest wait) gets an offer email.
Statuses are written **only after Gmail confirms the send**.

## Calendar cleanup
Renames the event **[CANCELLED]**, greys it out and marks it free. Checks the title first, so it is safe to repeat.

assignments.name: faq
assignments.value:
- Address: 1420 Maple Grove Avenue, Suite 200, Riverton. Free parking behind the building; wheelchair accessible.
- Phone: (555) 014-2290. Email: hello@bookwell.example
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8:00 AM–6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM–1:00 PM, closed Sundays and public holidays.
- Appointment windows: Morning = 8:00 AM–12:00 PM, Afternoon = 1:00 PM–6:00 PM (Saturday mornings only).
- Insurance: we accept BrightPath Health, Meridian Care, Unity Shield and Harbor Mutual plans, plus self-pay. Bring your insurance card and a photo ID. Self-pay visits start at $85.
- New patients: arrive 15 minutes early to complete forms; bring a list of current medications.
- Cancellation policy: cancel or reschedule at least 24 hours ahead by phone or by replying to your confirmation email. Late cancellations and no-shows may incur a $25 fee.
- Requests are tentative until a staff member confirms the exact time by email within one business day.
- Prescription refills and test results are handled by phone, not by email.

// Fed by two paths: sent offers (only if the email went out) and cancellations with nobody to offer to
